scope: Mechanical rebuild after R15 user review; nominal packaging only.
procurement_status: No orders placed; availability, exact supplier dimensions and material certificates remain open.
user_review_corrections: Rear rigid tail reduced to a short high-mounted connector exit; no low snagging tail body.
Six wheels are tied to the side pressure covers and all wheel axes are Z=45 mm, giving a 90 mm wheel bottom at Z=0.
Wheel service uses a recessed captive cross-pin and cap; no ordinary wrench or loose nut is required.
Old camera envelope replaced by a rounded armoured pod with recessed window, front guard and internal elastomer isolation.
Lift moved to the front-central body axis; two 80 mm links fold over the roof saddle and remain X=150 mm at LOW/HIGH centres.

mechanical_parts.part: Machined pressure body, rounded lower pipe-facing corners
mechanical_parts.note: Outer body X=0..307, Y=-46..46, Z=8..90; 3 mm side pressure membrane remains behind the gear bay.

mechanical_parts.role: isolated 40..160 VDC tether input to 24 V crawler bus
mechanical_parts.note: 60 W, 24 V/2.5 A nominal output. It replaces the RSD-100D-24 because the old 161x68x36 mm body conflicted with the two motor reserves. With DRV8871 traction current limited to 0.64 A/channel, the first 40 m demonstration has a nominal power margin; thermal and bus-fault tests are still required.
Wheel stations X=50/150/250; tire and metal hub are separate service solids so the wheel slides over the flange.

mechanical_parts.part: Recessed captive ball-lock cross-pin + retaining cap
mechanical_parts.note: Torque is carried by the keyed hub; pin carries axial retention only. Pull the transverse pin along X, then slide the wheel outward along Y. Add a stainless lanyard and verify mud/ice release.

mechanical_parts.part: Manual two-link lift with positive lock and 150 N gas-spring candidate
mechanical_parts.note: Low and high link lengths are both 80 mm; spring SKU/end fittings and hand load remain open.

mechanical_parts.part: Separate armoured camera pod for RunCam Phoenix 2 SE V2 envelope
mechanical_parts.note: Rounded shell, recessed 27 mm optical opening, front guard ring, replaceable four-sided bumper cage, shock isolator and two hand-release yoke pins. Exact lens/window stack is still a purchase gate.

mechanical_parts.part: Pololu 3046 HPCB 12 V 1000:1 camera gearmotor class
mechanical_parts.role: PAN / ROTATE actuator envelopes on protected yoke cheeks
mechanical_parts.note: Motors stay outside the sealed optical pod; each is replaceable from the yoke. Verify shaft, gear mesh, limit sensing and 12 V transient current on the exact received units.

mechanical_parts.part: Flush rear cover with high axial tether connector and integrated lowering eye
mechanical_parts.note: Connector shell is not the towing load path; aramid strain relief remains separate and flexible cable is not modeled as a rigid tail.

retained_electronics.traction_motors: 2x Pololu 4695 24 V gearmotor with encoder envelope
retained_electronics.camera: RunCam Phoenix 2 SE V2 board envelope

release_gates: Measure purchased wheel, flange, bearing, X-ring and cross-pin parts before machining.
Machine one wheel station mock-up and run axial pull, radial load, mud/ice release and submerged rotation tests.
Verify the selected camera board/lens and optical window actually fit the pod before sealing.
Perform continuous lift sweep with real yoke pins, cable loop and spring; CAD only checks LOW/HIGH poses.
Pressure-proof body/side/rear covers and run a full ideal/real ID150 tube sweep with tread, fasteners and deposits.
